name: print-social-gradient-poster-series-radial-blur-pink-blue-numbered
title: 'Series #2 Gradient' five-poster set with radial-blur pink-blue-yellow fields and minimal numbered labels
whatItIs: Five dark-bordered portrait posters numbered 001–005, each filled edge-to-edge with a soft radial-blur gradient (magenta-to-blue, teal-to-navy with concentric rings, pink-to-gold, blue-purple with rotated 'VER O U DE SIGN' type), labelled 'SERIES #2 GRADIENT' with small corner captions.
whatItMeans: Meditative and premium; treating pure colour blur as the entire image lets a poster series feel abstract and gallery-like.
techniques: Use only a radial gradient blur as the entire visual, no other imagery.
Number posters as a series with consistent corner labels.
Occasionally break the pure-gradient rule with thin ring lines or rotated type for variety.

vocabulary.definition: A gradient that blurs outward from a central point.
Labelling each piece in a set with a sequence number.
